messages:
ana: follow-up after the canary: we need clearer interfaces between the autoscaler and the operator for both durable slabs and slice-style leases. saw a few mistakes where autoscaler assumed an immediate reclaim and operator was doing graceful drain.

ben: agreed. we should formalize 3 admission surfaces: durable_slab, slice_lease, shared_pool. single admission decision point returns (path, reason, metadata). avoids guessing in caller.

yara: +1. metadata should include slab_id or lease_id and a lease_ttl when applicable so autoscaler can emit consistent metrics and traces.

ana: (typo) ana: also proposal: durable_slab = long-lived, right-sized using 7d p95; slice_lease = short bounded leases that map to MIG slices; both consume from region_budget. shared_pool uses ephemeral burst tokens.

ben: how to avoid double-counting capacity when a tenant holds both a durable slab and slice leases? need canonical accounting: assign each admission an "accounting_tag" and operator ledger sums by tag.

yara: operator ledger should expose /operator/v1/accounting?window=1h returns JSON (but per agents rules, don't add docs here). We'll just track that we need the endpoint.

orch-bot: deploy-note: operator v0.10 will emit events: AccountingUpdate tenant=<t> tag=<tag> delta_slots=+n.

ana: rollout plan: feature-flag admit-v2 behind env AUTO_ADMIT=v2. Start with 5% tenants, monitor: preemption_rate, coldstart_p95, slot_saturation_pct, accounting_delta_unexpected.

ben: tests: unit admit table-driven for path selection; chaos test that operator drains while autoscaler still thinks slab exists; property test to ensure no oscillation >1.5x in 3m.

yara: operator API: add POST /operator/v1/leases/<id>/force_release?reason=<>&force=true that returns draining_until and affected_allocations_count. orch-bot will post summarized events.

ana: good. also add probe-backoff to admission result: if path=queue, include backoff_ms. helps clients decide whether to retry.

ben: DSL example: ```yaml
admit_v2:
  durable:
    p95_window_days: 7
    alpha: 1.15
    min_slots: 1
    max_fraction: 0.08
  slice:
    idle_ttl_s: 3600
    max_per_tenant: 3
  region_burst:
    token_rate: 50
    bucket: 200
  probe:
    base_backoff_ms: 300
    max_backoff_ms: 4000
```

yara: metrics to add: admit_path_total{durable,slice,pool,queue}, lease_drain_seconds, accounting_conflicts; traces tag every token with path and lease_id.

ana: ops playbook snippet: if durable adoption causes pressure: 1) reduce durable_max_fraction 2) enable slab_eviction mode with TTL=10m 3) monitor accounting_conflicts and slot_saturation.

ben: one last thing: MIG packing. scheduler must expose FitScore(lease_size, node) and we should prefer contiguous placement. Add a fallback policy that consolidates cold slices nightly.

ana: ok i'll open an RFC follow-up PR in autoscaler and a tiny operator change set. assigning: @ben (admit API & tests), @yara (operator endpoints + events), @ana (RFC/rollout). i'll post PR links here when ready.

orch-bot: reminder: create canary dashboard: metrics mentioned above and set alerts for preemption_rate > 0.5% and slot_saturation_pct > 90%.

ana: thanks all. short sync tomorrow if needed.
